A special helmet for a special home race. Gabi pays tribute to his idol Ayrton Senna, 35 years after his win in Brazil. 🇧🇷
Don't forget to collect the Team Card: https://www.audif1.com/races/2026/sao-paulo-grand-prix/sao-paulo-gabi-special-helmet?utm_source=x&utm_medium=organic_social&utm_campaign=audif1_sao_paulo_gabi_special_helmet_2026_global
detailZh:
为一场特别的家乡赛事，一款特别的头盔。加比向他的偶像埃尔顿·塞纳致敬，距离他在巴西获胜已有35年。🇧🇷
别忘了收集车队卡片：https://www.audif1.com/races/2026/sao-paulo-grand-prix/sao-paulo-gabi-special-helmet?utm_source=x&utm_medium=organic_social&utm_campaign=audif1_sao_paulo_gabi_special_helmet_2026_global
